title: Migraine treatment online: prescriptions by message - FutureClinic
summary: Migraine treatment online: covers triptans, gepants, Cove, and Neura Health. On FutureClinic, a doctor reads your case by message for a $40 visit.
body_markdown:
## How do Neura Health, Cove, and FutureClinic compare?


Do you want a neurology membership or a recurring migraine subscription and its billing rules, or do you want a physician of your own whom you can message about your headaches whenever you need care?


If you want what another company sells beyond the doctor, it is a strong option. Neura Health suits patients wanting video visits with neurologists (or nurse practitioners and physician assistants), care from age 14, wider neurology care (epilepsy, sleep, tremor, concussion, stroke), or insurance billing (including some Medicare). As of October 2026, Neura costs $39/month or $105/quarter (after a $1 first week) plus $249 self-pay first visit and $154 follow-ups (or Neura Flex pay-per-visit); cancelling forfeits remaining period fees. Cove suits adults 18 to 64 wanting a migraine-only subscription ($10/month) and generics (from $15/month, billed quarterly) after a $99 consult ($30 average copay; insurance cannot cover medicine).


If you wanted an expert doctor one to one, FutureClinic gives you that with nothing attached. FutureClinic has over 300 doctors. They practice across more than 60 specialties, including primary care doctors and specialists. With no subscription required, a visit is $40 for the best-fit doctor, or a chosen doctor's listed price, typically $20 to $100. Most doctors offer an optional membership: unlimited care with that doctor, cancel any time, typically $25 to $100 a month.

## What do migraine visits and medicines cost over a year?


A low monthly price assumes you stay subscribed to keep getting refills. On FutureClinic, for a stable medicine, your doctor can prescribe several months at once when they judge it safe, to the pharmacy you choose (including mail-order delivery), where insurance may cover it or a discount coupon lowers the cash price. Over a year (as of October 2026), Cove's $99 consult, $10/month fee, and generics from $15/month total at least $399; Neura's membership and $249 first visit total $669 to $717 before $154 follow-ups. One $40 FutureClinic visit plus two 30-tablet fills of sumatriptan 50 mg on Cost Plus Drugs ($10.29 each plus $5.25 shipping, including its $5 dispensing fee) totals $71.08 if your doctor judges a multi-month prescription safe.


Other October 2026 cash prices: Cost Plus Drugs charges $6.59 (sumatriptan 50 mg, 9 tablets), $7.59 (rizatriptan 10 mg, 9 tablets), $5.44 (topiramate 25 mg, 30 tablets), and $9.52 (propranolol ER 80 mg, 30 capsules); GoodRx coupons are $16.67 (sumatriptan 50 mg, 9 tablets), $590.00 (Nurtec ODT, 8 tablets), $1,762.42 (Ubrelvy, 16 tablets), and $1,167.16 to $1,170.07 (Qulipta, 30 tablets); TrumpRx lists Aimovig at $299.00 (coupon), Emgality at $299.00 (LillyDirect), and Zavzpret at $594.84 (coupon).


## How to treat migraine with AI: messaging a physician in your state for rescue and preventive care


FutureClinic operates in 33 states and Washington, D.C.: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Montana, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin, Wyoming, and Washington, D.C. Your doctor must be licensed in your state; if you don't see yours, try anyway.


From Instinct, you get a text with a short note in your words and a link to FutureClinic's web chat. Start on[https://futureclinic.com](https://futureclinic.com/) or at[https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai](https://futureclinic.com/connect-your-ai) from ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex, Grok Bot or Meta Muse (see our[ChatGPT guide](https://futureclinic.com/blog/how-to-add-a-real-doctor-to-chatgpt) and[Claude guide](https://futureclinic.com/blog/how-to-add-a-doctor-to-claude) ), or send your AI:` Set up FutureClinic for me: read https://futureclinic.com/llms.txt`


Once it's connected, make sure you instruct your AI to use FutureClinic to help find you a doctor. Otherwise, it may not know that this is what you want.


> Use FutureClinic to help find me a doctor in my state to review my migraine symptoms.


FutureClinic is not for emergencies; call 911, or call or text 988 in a mental-health crisis.
